files.title: File:Peleg Cogeshall House. 1774 Nantucket Island.jpg
files.author: Bobkulin
files.caption: 1774 Peleg Cogeshall House at 9 Orange St. Nantucket Mass.  The plaque of the Nantucket Historical Society says that he was a cooper.  That is, a maker of wooden barrels that were carried on whaling ships to store whale oil.  This house had also been the home of Barzalai Ray, a crew member of the ill-fated ship, the Essex, which had been struck by a whale and sank.  This true story was used by Herman Melville in his writing of Moby Dick.
